title: QUIZ - 07
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Reduce a fraction to its simplest form using the greatest common factor
questions.question: Simplify the fraction \( 27/36 \) to its lowest terms.
questions.explanation: The greatest common factor of 27 and 36 is 9. Dividing numerator and denominator by 9 gives \( \frac{3}{4} \).
questions.hint: Divide the numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

questions.learningObjective: Simplify two fractions and compare their reduced values
questions.question: Two fractions, \( 25/30 \) and \( 24/42 \), are both simplified to lowest terms. Which statement is true?

options.label: B
options.text: The two simplified fractions are equal.

options.label: D
options.text: Neither fraction can be simplified further.

questions.explanation: Simplifying gives \( 25/30 \) = \( \frac{5}{6} \) and \( 24/42 \) = \( \frac{4}{7} \). Comparing these simplified values confirms the relationship stated in the correct option.
questions.hint: Simplify both fractions completely before comparing them.

questions.learningObjective: Identify which fraction is already fully reduced
questions.question: Which of the following fractions is already in its simplest (lowest-terms) form?
questions.explanation: A fraction is in lowest terms when its numerator and denominator share no common factor other than 1. \( \frac{3}{5} \) has gcd(3, 5) = 1, so it cannot be reduced further, while the other options share a common factor greater than 1.
questions.hint: Check whether the numerator and denominator share any common factor greater than 1.
